# PN Parfüm (Pien Parfum)

> PN Parfüm (Pien Parfum) is a Turkish perfume manufacturer producing since 2002 (24 years of experience) at its head office and laboratory in Silivri, İstanbul. It sells perfumes online, builds private-label and "PN umbrella" series for entrepreneurs, and works with distributors worldwide. Laboratory offers 400 different fragrance options. Languages: Turkish, English, Arabic.

Key facts
- Brands and lines: Pien Series (everyday, affordable, 20% fragrance concentration), Pien Intense (specially designed scents, higher concentration), Aşık Parfüm (special-occasion series, high concentration), Pien Luxury (100 ml luxury collection), PN (everyday, first-class essence, special series), PN Special Series (100 ml).
- Services for entrepreneurs: fragrance design, trademark registration guidance, logo design, bottle selection, box design (through partner printers), label design, contract manufacturing, and a series under the PN umbrella (e.g. example series MIX and AGORA) with lower cost and more flexible quantities. Scope, quantities and terms are agreed per project.
- Distributor applications are preliminary requests and do not include regional exclusivity or a contract guarantee.
- Contact: info@pnparfume.com, +90 212 736 09 90, Mon–Fri 09:00–18:00 (Türkiye time).
